sources.title: Ledger Lens data and consent policy

clauses.summary: Evidence about an applicant is processed only after the applicant consents, and the consent is recorded with its time and method.

sources.title: Public sanctions lists (UN Security Council Consolidated List and national lists)

clauses.summary: Lenders must not provide funds to listed persons. Applicants and guarantors are screened by name; a possible match is a question for a person, not a rejection.

rules.title: Applicant consent recorded before processing
rules.pass_detail: Consent was recorded before any evidence was processed.
rules.fail_detail: No recorded consent. Stop processing and obtain consent.

rules.title: Applicant and guarantor screened against sanctions lists
rules.pass_detail: No names matched the sanctions lists.
rules.fail_detail: A name is similar to a listed person. Verify identity documents before deciding.
